rationale: With only 27 minutes to close, REGN is already up ~6.2% on strong earnings beat news and sitting at 88% of its intraday range near the session high — the easy momentum move has already occurred. The 1-minute candles show choppy, low-conviction price action oscillating in a tight ~$4 band with declining volume, offering no clear directional setup. The broad market is under significant stress (SPY -2.18%, VIXY +13.14%), which creates cross-current risk for a late-day long, while shorting a strong earnings gap-up name into the close carries its own squeeze risk; the risk/reward in either direction is unfavorable this late in the session.
